headline: The Wall Street Journal reports that OpenAI has made progress in stopping ChatGPT from fuelling delusions in its users.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: the article could not be read and no other outlet carries it, so its content is unverified.
importance_line: ChatGPT users prone to delusional thinking could be better protected if the progress holds, but how much progress was made, and how it was measured, is not yet clear.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that OpenAI is making progress in preventing AI-driven delusions among ChatGPT users.
notes: WSJ page returned HTTP 401 (subscription wall); two Google News searches found no other outlet carrying the story. Entry restates the title with attribution only.
